locations.summary: Davis Quartz is a terraced mining site in GTA V and GTA Online. It is located on Senora Way, to the east of Sandy Shores and southeast of the Grand Senora Desert.

locations.name: Dignity Village
locations.summary: Dignity Village is an unincorporated tent city established by homeless people near Procopio Beach, located in Blaine County, San Andreas. locations.summary: Mount Gordo is one of four named mountain peaks in San Andreas in GTA V and GTA Online, the others being Mount Chiliad, Mount Josiah, and Mount Haan. Mount Gordo is the smallest of the three. It is located in the northeast of Blaine County. A small lake can be found here, as well as a small pond.

locations.name: North Chumash
locations.summary: North Chumash is a small unincorporated community located in Blaine County, San Andreas, that appears in GTA V and GTA Online. It is mainly a residential area with some shops.

cheats.name: Give weapons
cheats.note: Adds the following to the player's inventory: Knife; SMG with 300 bullets; Assault Rifle with 300 bullets; Pump Shotgun with 150 bullets; Sniper Rifle with 30 bullets; 5 Grenades; RPG with 5 rockets

cheats.name: Max health and armor
cheats.note: Also repairs the player's vehicle, if driving one.

cheats.name: Wanted Level up
cheats.note: Raises level by 1. Cheat will be denied at 5 stars.

cheats.name: Wanted Level down
cheats.note: Lowers level by 1. Cheat will be denied at no wanted level.

cheats.name: Spawn Dodo Sea Plane
cheats.note: Must be unlocked by completing Sea Plane.

cheats.name: Spawn Duke O'Death
cheats.note: Must be unlocked by completing Duel.

cheats.name: Spawn Kraken submersible
cheats.note: Must be unlocked by completing Wildlife Photography Challenge.

cheats.name: Advance Weather
cheats.note: Cycles through: Extra sunny weather; Clear weather; Cloudy weather; Smoggy weather; Overcast weather; Rainy weather; Thundery weather; Clearing weather; Snowy weather

cheats.name: Slow Motion
cheats.note: Cycles through 3 levels, slowing the game down to 60%, 40%, and 20%, respectively, of its original speed. The time scale is reset back to normal after entering the cheat a fourth time.

cheats.name: Skyfall
cheats.note: The player is warped to the sky 500 meters above their current position and free-falls to the ground. Similarly to free-falling with a Parachute, the speed and direction of the fall can be controlled. The player will be invulnerable to fall damage until they make contact with any surface for the first time, however the force of the landing might still end up killing the player afterwards.

cheats.name: Slow motion aim
cheats.note: Cycles through 3 levels, slowing the game down to 60%, 40%, and 20%, respectively, of its original speed. The time scale is reset back to normal after entering the cheat a fourth time.
